verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service documents scanning official mail and uploading it to a secure cloud storage account for access from anywhere. It also sends email alerts and reminders when mail arrives, and the documents sit in a personalized dashboard. That covers the core of the story: scanned state mail you can read online. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloading scanned mail, sharing of scanned mail (sharing is only documented for business licenses), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
